name: Sound Steps 2
organisation: Yorkshire Youth & Music and Umbrella Yoga
whoFor: Young people aged 18 to 24 who want to build creative music skills while looking after their wellbeing.  Activities include, song writing, music production, instrumental skills and Djing.  Working collaboratively in small groups supported by a music leader. No previous music experience necessary.
eligibility: Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)

selfReferral.note: Yes, using the sign-up link on the website

projects.name: Sound Steps 2
projects.overview: Weekly sessions in songwriting, beat-making, recording, music production and DJing, led by experienced professional music leaders, supporting wellbeing, teamwork and personal development.

sessions.name: Sound Steps Yoga and Wellbeing
sessions.note: term time only until end of February
